name: coordination/dispatch-reply
description: `dispatch` on the coordination surface: the operator's one-shot consent receipt is spent and the dispatch is committed in one store transaction (ADR-0016 §2). `consent_spent` is always true on a successful reply, `replayed` distinguishes a fresh commit from an execution-key retry, and `egress` names the one part this build does not do — the bytes have not left the machine, and the reply says so rather than implying they have.

egress.detail: the outbound A2A carrier for a staged coordination payload is not decided (ADR-0016 leaves the per-phase carrier table open); the consent receipt is spent and no bytes have left this machine
